title: Booking a follow-up
summary: A patient books her follow-up from the dashboard in four screens.

steps.title: The follow-up is waiting
steps.caption: The dashboard leads with the visit the provider asked for, so the patient does not have to remember to book it.
steps.fixes: Patients forgetting to book the follow-up

steps.title: Every free time on one screen
steps.caption: The next days sit in a strip, with the free times for the day picked underneath. One tap picks a time.

steps.title: One look before booking
steps.caption: The visit, the time and the place, on one card. Confirm books it.

steps.title: Booked
steps.caption: The visit is on her list, with a way to move it if plans change.
